Product Features

  • Size: 100 x 50 x 40 cm, offers additional storage space for everyday items, is easily accessible, keeps the living room tidy and is the best choice for modern apartments.
  • Smart lighting: The semi-open storage area features integrated LED light strips that can be controlled via a mobile app. This allows you to adjust the lighting mode as desired, creating a great atmosphere for living room gatherings, birthday parties, and other activities.
  • Coffee table in high-gloss white: The drawer fronts are finished in a high-gloss lacquer, giving the table an elegant, minimalist look that blends seamlessly into any interior style. The tabletop is easy to clean – simply wipe it with a damp cloth so you can enjoy your afternoon tea in peace. (The high-gloss finish is limited to the drawer fronts.)
  • Ample storage space: The double-layered, modern coffee table offers you plenty of space to display various accessories or items such as magazines, books, remote controls or other living room utensils, thus ensuring a tidy and organized workspace.
  • Tempered glass top panel: Explosion-proof tempered glass top panel, waterproof and moisture-resistant, full of design sense, making the entire room structure more multi-layered, durable and stable for daily use and capable of being used continuously for many years.
  • Ample storage space: This two-tiered coffee table for the living room features a glass-topped shelf and two pull-out drawers for convenient storage of notebooks, books, remote controls, and other everyday items. Keep your room neat and organized.
  • Cleverly organized: Our living room coffee table features two spacious drawers that conveniently store essential items like magazines, gaming accessories, and more, keeping things tidy. Thanks to the open shelves, you have quick access to your remote control or phone when needed.
  • Multifunctional and versatile: This piece of furniture can be used as a side table for books and drinks, as a reading lamp, or for interior design. Our white living room table is the ideal choice for your home.
  • Stylish design: This LED furniture impresses with its white design, which exudes an elegant, modern aesthetic and makes it a stylish addition to any living room decor. The white color option is suitable for many types of living rooms.
  • Easy to care for: Modern coffee tables are less susceptible to stains and scratches than lighter-colored models. This makes them easier to keep clean and tidy.
